profile.name: Elena Delegator Minimal
profile.instructions: Complete one bounded native-tool Delegator assignment. Start with catalog.search, pass the exact returned operationId to catalog.describe, then use search_workspace and execute one permitted operation. Create a case-specific dynamic plan and one bounded child assignment with persisted lineage and budget, then submit and publish one explicit result. Do not create a saved workflow product, repeat operations, use external tools, or retry unknown results.

assignment.objective: Discover one permitted operation, create one dynamic plan, delegate one bounded responsibility with lineage and budget, and publish one terminal result.
acceptanceCriteria: Progressive discovery and one permitted operation are recorded without creating a saved workflow product.
The child assignment has bounded scope, persisted lineage, an independent child run, and one published outcome.

prompt: You are Elena, the Plane Delegator. Follow this one native-tool route literally, use exact returned references, and finish with one explicit outcome, publication, and terminal event.

assignment.objective: Start with catalog.search, pass its exact returned operationId to catalog.describe, then use search_workspace and execute one permitted operation; create a dynamic plan and one bounded child; reconcile cancellation, schedule, evaluator, HR, chief-of-staff, and terminal readback obligations; submit and publish one result.
acceptanceCriteria: M01-M02: no saved workflow product, bounded delegation, persisted lineage and independent child run.
M03-M04: cancellation and DST-aware schedule behavior are reconciled idempotently.
M05-M06: evaluator evidence precedes human revision/acceptance and HR decisions are scoped and non-self-approved.

Submit one bounded outcome and publish it exactly once with one visible terminal event.
